data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, independent of others—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching10→18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled, but reduces remainder by8 and low-outcome stock by16. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. This isn't guaranteed best long-term.
